en.headline: Two workers injured after falling from crane platform in Aberdeen
en.dek: A 62-year-old man and a 57-year-old woman fell about six metres when the platform of a crane truck became unstable during exterior wall work on Shek Pai Wan Road on Thursday morning.
body: Two workers were injured on Thursday morning after falling from an unstable platform on a crane truck while carrying out exterior wall maintenance in Aberdeen.

The accident happened at about 10:16 am at No. 100A Shek Pai Wan Road, near the Fisheries and Marine Department building. The platform was suspected to have become unstable, sending the pair to the ground from a height of about six metres.
Rescuers found the 62-year-old male worker semi-conscious and the 57-year-old female worker conscious but with a head injury. Both were taken to Queen Mary Hospital for treatment.
Police are investigating the industrial accident.

zh.headline: 香港仔兩工人從吊臂工作台墮下受傷
zh.dek: 周四早上約10時16分，石排灣道香港仔漁業及海事分署附近，吊臂車工作台疑不穩，兩名工人從約六米高墮地，分別送瑪麗醫院。
body: 周四早上，香港仔石排灣道發生工業意外，兩名工人在進行外牆維修時從吊臂車工作台墮下受傷。
意外發生在約上午10時16分，地點為石排灣道100A號香港仔漁業及海事分署附近。當時使用吊臂車進行外牆工程，工作台懷疑不穩，導致一名男工及一名女工從約六米高墮地。
救援人員到場時，62歲男工人神智半清醒，57歲女工人清醒但頭部受傷。兩人被送往瑪麗醫院治理。
警方正調查這宗工業意外。
